description: Send a seller net sheet and contact details to Abdilla and Associates (Illinois real estate attorney Justin Abdilla) so the firm can open the seller's closing file. Use after estimate_seller_net_sheet when the user, a listing agent or a seller, wants Justin to handle the closing. IMPORTANT: only call this with the user's explicit consent to share their name, email and phone; the firm will contact them. Submitting does not create an attorney-client relationship; the firm confirms in writing.

net_sheet_inputs.description: The inputs object from estimate_seller_net_sheet (structuredContent.inputs), so the firm receives the same net sheet

notes.description: Contract status, attorney review deadline, lender, anything else

seller_name.description: Seller's name, if the sender is the agent

name: open_seller_closing_file
title: Open a seller closing file
